name: deletion-asked-by-operator
subject: Your Permaily account is being deleted

blocks.text: Permaily's operator asked to delete your Permaily account. It will be removed, with everything in it, on 19 November 2026, 09:30 UTC.
Until then you can sign in at app.permaily.com and cancel the deletion.
To ask why, write to support@permaily.com.
